newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KFA buys 52,000T of corn at $160.77/T C&F -traders.
newsitem.headline: KFA buys 52,000T of corn at $160.77/T C&F -traders.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association's (KFA) office in Pusan had bought late last week 52,000 tonnes of corn at $160.77 per tonne on a cost and freight basis (C&F), traders said on Tuesday.
The traders said the KFA had bought the corn from Toepfer in a private negotiation. The origin was set on seller's option, but it would be from Argentina, they added.
Arrival was set for the port cities of Pusan and Ulsan by July 5, 1997.
